name: Pattern Bite
description: Pattern spider venom table for Sidereal Exalted. Roll 1d10 when Paradox reaches 10.

results.text: Power-Neutralizing Venom: The Sidereal loses all her motes and attunements, and cannot regain motes for one to 10 days.
Blunted Mind Venom: The Sidereal loses all her Willpower and cannot regain Willpower for one to 10 days.
Burning Muscle Venom: The Sidereal suffers a −3 wound penalty for one to 10 weeks. This cannot be neutralized or modified and stacks with other wound penalties.
Divine Anesthetic Venom: The Sidereal suffers −1 to permanent Essence for one to 10 weeks. She cannot raise her Essence during this time.
Resolve-Decaying Venom: The Sidereal cannot benefit from the effects of channeling Virtues for the remainder of the story.
Essence-Weeping Venom: +1 mote to the cost of each Charm activation for one to 10 days, and the character cannot activate Combos or take sorcery actions. Necromancy actions are unaffected.
Visage-Twisting Venom: The Sidereal is reduced to Appearance 0 for one to 10 months.

Black Voyage Venom: The Sidereal falls into a deep sleep for one to 10 days, dreaming terrible nightmares of endless toil at the Loom. No force can awaken her before the duration expires. When she does awaken, she has no temporary Willpower points, though this does not affect her ability to regain them.
Essence Venom: The character immediately suffers one to 10 dice of aggravated damage.

Dead Wife Venom: An Essence 1 mortal the character loves dies horribly. If the character does not love any such person, the venom lurks until she does, and then acts immediately. This is the only pattern spider venom to which one can cultivate immunity.
